newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bonds, PIBOR end stable, quiet Friday seen.
newsitem.headline: French bonds, PIBOR end stable, quiet Friday seen.

text.p: 1500 GMT - June bond future settles little changed after trading in narrow range ahead of public holiday on Thursday. June PIBOR also ends steady, below earlier highs, on guard for polls showing left gaining on right. Franc slightly higher vs mark at 3.3736. Very quiet session expected Friday. *Jun 10-yr future 129.52, up 0.04. Vol 70,743. Open 129.52 *5.50 2007 OAT yield unch 5.68 pct. Bund spread -9 vs -7 bp *Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Jun PIBOR 96.35, up 1 bp
